structure: CSharp DeclareFunctions owns an ordinal canonical-name dictionary in source order; duplicate lookup precedes BindFunctionDeclaration and all body validation. SLG functionNameDiagnostic uses canonical namespace/dotted declaration bytes and exact byte equality in its indexed declaration table. Top-level declaration rejections are explicit CheckedPreparation values.
branches: Top-level duplicates across signatures reject; separate namespace and local scopes remain separate. Earlier invalid signatures retain priority; a duplicate declaration before its own invalid signature or any body failure is selected first. Ordinary and cache-enabled preparation apply the same decision; all seven production entrypoint consumers handle DeclarationRejected.
logic: Compare declaration source-module and lexical name position with first prepared signature rejection. A valid declaration does not override a signature error. The renderer reuses appendFunctionDeclarationName, so duplicate detection and diagnostic spelling consume the same canonical name. No overload-based exemption, fallback or name-specific branch.
diagnostics: Exact original ten CSharp diagnostics/output controls matched actual SLG and general Native. Cache-enabled ten retained their original sources/oracles; three valid warm controls proved restoration and LLVM equivalence. Historical cache dependency closure drift after integration is preserved and is not claimed current whole-compiler proof.
